summary: Rebuilds bundled ORAS and Cosign with patched Go and compression dependencies in installer and manager images.
userImpact: Plugin installation and artifact verification tools use patched binaries while retaining their existing CLI versions.

instructions: Use the rebuilt installer and manager images when the containing release is published.

security: Go 1.26.10 remediates CVE-2026-111943 in both bundled tools; klauspost/compress 1.18.7 remediates CVE-2026-63209 in Cosign.
rollback: Reverting the toolchain image changes restores the previously vulnerable binaries.
validation: Pinned-scanner exact Linux arm64 installer/manager scans pass the committed HIGH/CRITICAL policy. The same four-image gate also passes the unchanged all-severity backend/frontend policy.
Patched ORAS and Cosign build for Linux arm64 and amd64; compiled binary metadata confirms Go 1.26.10 and the patched compression dependency.

The disposable local OCI rehearsal passes actual bundled tool execution, signatures, deterministic charts, digest repulls, signed offline-bundle verification, tamper rejection and disconnected-registry import.
Toolchain release policy, package/chart version bindings, dependency security floors and documentation boundary checks pass.
